confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely with July high-season demand and the sharp price gap between hostels and hotels. Cocktail and wine anchors are set from local beer and pisco-sour price relationships. The FX observation was taken from a search summary attributed to the RBA overview page; I did not open the RBA table directly, and the 16 October rate was not confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Chilean high-altitude tourist towns and the Atacama tourism circuit, priced against Santiago with a remote-destination premium for food, drink and lodging. Accommodation assumes July winter high season.
